احتوشوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَوَشُوا (iḥtawašū) /iħ.ta.wa.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# اُحْتُوِشُوا (uḥtuwišū) /uħ.tu.wi.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# اِحْتَوِشُوا (iḥtawišū) /iħ.ta.wi.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
